mapper.sql: server_id, name, host, port, host_key_sha256, enabled, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO train_server (name, host, port, host_key_sha256, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{host}, #{port}, #{hostKeySha256}, #{enabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM train_server s
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT a.account_id FROM train_server_account a WHERE a.server_id = s.server_id AND a.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId})
ORDER BY server_id
mapper.update: UPDATE train_server SET enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE server_id = #{serverId}
